items.t: West Vancouver real estate market stats

faq.q: Is Bayridge an official West Vancouver neighbourhood?
faq.a: No official District neighbourhood or planning-area name "Bayridge" was confirmed in District sources — it is a local area/site name for the West Bay–Westmount slope in the District of West Vancouver, covered District-wide by the Official Community Plan, Bylaw No. 4985, 2018.

faq.q: Which public elementary school is in the area?
faq.a: West Bay Elementary, 3175 Thompson Place, Kindergarten to Grade 7, offering the International Baccalaureate Primary Years Programme. For that sample address the SD45 locator gives West Bay Elementary and Rockridge Secondary (8–12); SD45 has no middle tier and catchments are address-based.

faq.q: What bus serves Marine Drive by Bayridge?
faq.a: Route 250 runs between Vancouver and Dundarave and Horseshoe Bay via Marine Drive, through Park Royal and over the Lions Gate Bridge.

faq.q: What hazard permits can apply on a waterfront or creek-side lot?
faq.a: A Foreshore Development Permit in the Foreshore Development Permit Area, an Environmental Development Permit for work within 15 metres of the top of a watercourse bank, and a Wildfire Hazard Development Permit within 100 metres of an undisturbed forest interface.

faq.q: When were West Vancouver property taxes due in 2026?
faq.a: July 2, 2026, with a 5% penalty on unpaid current taxes on July 2, 2026 and a further 5% on outstanding current taxes on September 2, 2026; about half the bill is collected for other taxing authorities.
